title: PQR：生成引发问答智能体故障的多样且真实用户查询的框架
summary: PQR框架通过查询精炼和提示精炼两个模块的迭代交互，自动生成能触发LLM智能体故障的多样且真实用户查询，无需大量人工设计。在电商QA智能体评估中，相比现有方法，PQR发现的无帮助响应增加了23%-78%，且生成的查询更多样、更真实。
summary_en: PQR is a framework that automatically generates diverse and realistic user queries that trigger LLM agent failures through iterative interaction between query refinement and prompt refinement modules. It uncovers 23%-78% more unhelpful responses in e-commerce QA agent evaluation, with more diverse and realistic queries than prior methods.
